written: 2026-11-03, before any simulated tree was coarsened (phase 1c, step 2)

rules.inflation: Demol et al. 2022 (Silva Fennica 56(1) 10550, §3.2, Table 3): diameter +73% under 2.5 cm, +4% over 10 cm, both measured on two leaf-off Fraxinus; log-interpolated between (not measured). One bracket point, at d_min × 1. Order: inflate, prune, re-cut
rules.datasets_note: BioDiv's resolution is measured on its beech (the only BioDiv QSMs fetched) and applied to oak
rules.shift: per seed, the median over the stand's live measured trees (STAND_MEASURED, alive at 150) of describe(coarsen(tree)) − describe(tree)
rules.pass: |shift| <= tolerance on >= 15 of the 20 seeds, at every bracket point and the inflation point, at each of the species' datasets
rules.fail: a seed with no live measured tree, or a NaN shift (the descriptor not computable at the resolution), counts as a fail
rules.held_out: gate c failed, or noise floor >= 0.5 × between-tree SD, or fewer than MIN_TREES finite real trees
rules.survive: per species, over its gated descriptors (DESCRIPTORS less report-only and H1-excluded): if fewer than half pass, stop and report; never loosen
rules.h2: ldSlope under the inflation point moves toward the dataset's QSM median: the gap closed is median shift / (QSM median − simulated median, uncoarsened), on beech at Demol and BioDiv. 'Hard' means at least half the gap closed
rules.h3: tortuosity and tortuosity05 (0.5 m resampling) reported on the real QSMs, the simulated trees and the coarsened ones
rules.control: each real QSM coarsened at its own dataset's resolution (× 1, no inflation): the shift should be near zero; a large one says the re-cut moves the descriptor by construction

h1_note: oak: the user's ruling; maple: extended (same dataset), the user's to confirm
